config.title: Simulated Hearing Setup
config.subtitle: Customize your training by choosing the AI Judge profile
config.judgeNamePlaceholder: Ex: Dr. Silva or Instructor Judge
config.judgeNameHint: How do you want to address the authority in the simulation?

calm.label: Calm
calm.desc: Maintains a steady pace and encourages patient dialogue during the hearing.

aggressive.label: Aggressive
aggressive.desc: Quickly challenges arguments and demands rapid precision in responses.

impartial.label: Impartial
impartial.desc: Strictly follows procedural rules without showing any bias.

empathetic.label: Empathetic
empathetic.desc: Focuses on the human element of the case and shows sensitivity to testimony.

pragmatic.label: Pragmatic
pragmatic.desc: Values efficiency, direct answers and avoids procedural delays.

researcher.label: Researcher
researcher.desc: Dives deep into legal precedents and complex technical details.

tip.title: Training Tip
tip.desc: We recommend starting with the Impartial profile to master the basic procedure. For advanced oral argument challenges, try the Aggressive profile.
